name: Suzuki B-King
engine: 1340 cc liquid-cooled inline four (Hayabusa engine), fuel injected
intro: The naked Hayabusa. Fuel injected and huge. 2008 bikes are in a regulator/rectifier recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2008 B-Kings are in recall 16V018 for the regulator/rectifier.
A-002.reason: A failed regulator can stall the engine. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Regulator/rectifier can fail and stop charging the battery, which can stall the engine.
